events.description: Official organizer confirms Sept 18–19, 2027 and free admission. Rare public static aircraft display featuring military and civilian aircraft, opportunities to enter selected aircraft and meet pilots and crews. Organizer's about page https://www.tributetoaviation.com/about-2/ confirms interior tours and child-friendly programming. 2027 aircraft list, daily hours and any entry/security instructions are not yet announced; no registration requirement or deadline posted. Static tours, not a promise of flight. Approx. 298–301 road miles from Westminster city center; overnight trip advisable. 2027 family-period event.
